Foro Italico — Rome, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Foro Italico is Rome's major sports complex, home to the Stadio Olimpico (the city's main football stadium, shared by Roma and Lazio) and the Foro Italico tennis and athletics grounds. On non-event days it is a quiet mix of sporting facilities and parkland along the Tiber, with only routine reports of pickpocketing near tourist and transit points. Match days are a different story: press documented clashes between fans and police outside the Olimpico before the April 2025 Lazio-Roma derby that left 13 officers injured, and further incidents in January 2026 when two German fans were attacked before a Roma-Stuttgart match. These are recurring, well-documented public-order flare-ups tied specifically to high-tension fixtures, not a general nightly risk for the area - hence a cautious yellow rather than red.
